statement: The recorded dose is **not safe or correct** for this 6.0 kg, 5-month-old infant: 480 mg is approximately 80 mg/kg, far above the usual single acetaminophen dose of 10–15 mg/kg. I will not administer it; please urgently clarify the order with the prescriber/pharmacist.
judge_text:
WRONG  
The answer states "480 mg is approximately 80 mg/kg, far above the usual single acetaminophen dose of 10–15 mg/kg" and refuses to administer.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
